samples.diagnosis: Your algorithm succeeded on small inputs but exceeded the linear time threshold on large arrays (12,000+ elements). Using nested loops forces the processor to make up to N*(N-1)/2 comparisons.
samples.single_actionable_improvement: Replace the nested loop with a hash map (Python dict): as you iterate through the list, compute `target - num` and look it up in O(1) average time instead of scanning the rest of the list.
